title: IMAP auth_failures counter not reset after successful auth
description: imap/session/mod.rs: auth_failures is incremented on failed AUTHENTICATE. On successful auth, the counter is not reset. If a client makes 2 failed attempts, then succeeds, then logs out and re-authenticates in the same session (e.g., via UNSELECT and re-AUTHENTICATE — which IMAP allows), a subsequent single failure would hit the MAX_AUTH_FAILURES=3 limit and disconnect the authenticated session. This is a minor correctness issue: the failure counter should be reset to 0 on any successful authentication.
